summary: Iteration 56 — Re-verified the roster-upload safety net. Both the /api/roster/jobs/active broadening AND the new POST /api/roster/jobs/{id}/acknowledge behave exactly per spec. All 6 acceptance tests in test_iter56_roster_active_and_acknowledge.py PASS. The previously red iter55 test 'test_active_endpoint_returns_needs_review_stub' now PASSES against server.py:2566. Frontend smoke check: with a stubbed needs_review job for the seeded client, Client Home renders the amber 'plan-needs-review-banner' with correct copy and the 'plan-review-open' link, and NEXT 7 DAYS still opens with 'Today' → 'Tomorrow'. No new bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:2566 roster_active_job — correct: $or across [queued/processing] OR [needs_review|partial|failed within 7d AND client_acknowledged != true]. Sort by updated_at desc/created_at desc is sensible.
server.py:2595 roster_job_acknowledge — correct 404 on non-existent job; sets client_acknowledged=true + acknowledged_at. Idempotent (safe to call twice).

Minor: acknowledge endpoint currently allows acknowledging queued/processing jobs too (does not restrict to needs_review/partial/failed). Not a bug — frontend only ever calls it from the amber banner — but you may want to guard it later so a client can't accidentally hide a live processing job.

Minor: acknowledge sets client_acknowledged before checking status. Consider also blocking ack on status in queued/processing to prevent client from dismissing an in-flight job, though the endpoint would still work (queued/processing branch of /active ignores client_acknowledged).

success_rate.backend: 100% (6/6 tests pass, incl. iter55 previously-red acceptance test)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (banner renders + Today at top of NEXT 7 DAYS)
